statement: For every r>=1, ordinary local J^r restriction over C is universally surjective exactly in dimensions N<=r+1; the same universal range holds integrally
depends_on: Target dimension; C.3ai for r+2<=N<=2r+1; C.3m for r1,N>=4; C.3aj for r>=2,N>=2r+2
notes: Excellent normal strictly henselian local complex rings with residue C, regular puncture and regular principal divisor puncture; ordinary fixed-product algebraic equivalence. The positive range is target zero. Every other dimension has a specified nontorsion cokernel witness. Higher injectivity and positive-characteristic higher restriction remain separate.
